en: Sanidassanattika, Saññojanagocchakādi (The Triplet on the Visible, the Chapter on Fetters, etc.)

Dependent on a state that is non-visible, non-reacting, and not a fetter, there arises a state that is non-visible, non-reacting, and a fetter, by way of root condition. (Abbreviated. Three for root; ... pe ... three for non-disappearance.

Dependent on a state that is non-visible, non-reacting, and not a tie, there arises a state that is non-visible, non-reacting, and a tie, by way of root condition. (Abbreviated. Three for root; ... pe ... three for non-disappearance.
Dependent on a state that is non-demonstrable, non-reactive, and not a flood, there arises a state that is non-demonstrable, non-reactive, and a flood, by way of root condition. (Abbreviated.
Three [answers] for root; ... pe ... three for non-disappearance.
Dependent on a state that is non-demonstrable, non-reactive, and not a bond, there arises a state that is non-demonstrable, non-reactive, and a bond, by way of root condition. (Abbreviated.)
With respect to the root condition: three … pe … with respect to non-disappearance: three.

Dependent on a state that is non-visible-and-non-resistant and not an hindrance, there arises a state that is invisible, non-resistant, and an hindrance, by way of the root condition. (Abbreviated. With respect to the root condition:
three … pe … with respect to non-disappearance: three.

Dependent on a state that is non-demonstrable, non-reactive, and not associated with clinging, there arises a state that is non-demonstrable and non-reactive, which is associated with clinging, by way of root condition. (Abbreviated.
Under root condition there are three; ... pe ... under non-disappearance condition there are three.
